args: Lost B2B Wholesale Deals: When Does Activity Happen Relative to the Deal's Life

For deals that eventually get lost, does sales activity cluster early, stay steady throughout, or come in a late flurry right before the deal is given up on — or does it go quiet before the end (stalled and forgotten)?

{"run": "run6", "manager": "b2b", "analyst": "Daniel Kim", "engineer": "Ines", "situation": "b2b-pipeline-review", "week": 2, "night": 1, "request": 1, "grain": "one row per lifecycle quartile (relative position within each lost opportunity's own created_at-to-closed_at window)", "columns_requested": ["lifecycle_quartile (Q1 0-25%, Q2 25-50%, Q3 50-75%, Q4 75-100% of the deal's own duration)", "total_activities_in_bucket", "pct_of_total_activities", "opportunities_with_at_least_one_activity_in_bucket", "pct_of_lost_opportunities_with_activity_in_bucket"], "details": "Scope: tenants.name IN ('Ballycorran Industrial Supply','Castell Fasteners','Hanse Industriebedarf','Midland Safety Wear','Polder Packaging'), pipeline_id = each tenant's 'New business' pipeline, opportunities where is_closed = true and is_won = false. For each such opportunity, join activities where activities.opportunity_id = opportunity.id. For each activity compute relative_position = (activity.occurred_at - opportunity.created_at) / NULLIF(opportunity.closed_at - opportunity.created_at, 0), expressed as a fraction of the deal's own lifespan. Bucket into quartiles: Q1 [0, 0.25), Q2 [0.25, 0.5), Q3 [0.5, 0.75), Q4 [0.75, 1.0] inclusive of activities right at closed_at. If any activity falls outside [0,1] (e.g. logged after closed_at, or the opportunity has zero duration), put it in a 5th 'outside window' bucket rather than discarding it, and flag how many rows that affects. total_activities_in_bucket = count of activities in that bucket; pct_of_total_activities = that count / total activities across all lost opportunities in scope; opportunities_with_at_least_one_activity_in_bucket = distinct opportunity count; pct_of_lost_opportunities_with_activity_in_bucket = that count / total lost opportunities in scope (a fixed denominator across rows). Order Q1 through Q4, then 'outside window' last if present.", "builds_on": ["New Business Only: Won vs Lost Opportunity Characteristics"]}
